items.html: *And behold, we have already explained above that there are two kinds of couplings for Aba and Ima of Atzilut: the first is their being equal and long, in all the height of their stature; the second is their being of short stature, as above, which is the secret of Yeshsut. And behold, these two kinds of couplings also exist in ZON: the first is when ZON are equal in their stature; the second is when the Nukva reaches only up to the chest of ZA, while they are back to back. Now, the first coupling is called the face-to-face (Panim be-Panim) coupling, and the second is called back to back (Achor be-Achor). And now that you know the divisions of ABYA, how they are, we will explain and say: behold, since all the existence of procreation of new souls is only through the upper Mochin of Aba and Ima, as above, therefore, up to the place that the illumination of the coupling of Aba and Ima reaches, there is there the aspect of procreation and coupling; but from there and onward there is no coupling.
